_v1_notes.FAILURE POINT|DETECTION MECHANISM: manufacturing/air freight/distribution x patient adverse event are all N: an excursion caught only when a patient is harmed implies no release testing at all, contradicting GMP. Final-mile and end-user x telemetry are N: uninstrumented vehicles and domestic refrigerators provide no instrumentation. End-user x spot check is N: there is no receiving point below the clinic.
_v1_notes.FAILURE POINT|PRODUCT TYPE: air freight x whole blood is N: shelf life in days does not survive multi-day sealed transit. End-user x whole blood is N: whole blood is not stored by end users.
_v1_notes.FAILURE POINT|RESPONSE: final-mile x expedite is N: stock already out for delivery cannot be expedited. End-user x re-test is N (no assay capability at a clinic fridge), x expedite is N, x notify-only is N (product already in patients' reach means there is immediate risk).
_v1_notes.DETECTION MECHANISM|PRODUCT TYPE: patient adverse event x mRNA vaccine is N and x whole blood is N: both fail irreversibly and visibly long before administration, so clinical harm is not the detection route.
_v1_notes.DETECTION MECHANISM|RESPONSE: patient adverse event x re-test/expedite/notify-only are all N: once harm has occurred, only quarantine is coherent. Batch recall audit x expedite is N: an audit that finds a fault cannot conclude with expediting the same stock.
_v1_notes.PRODUCT TYPE|RESPONSE: mRNA and whole blood x re-test, expedite, notify-only are all N: neither is salvageable and both carry immediate patient risk, so quarantine is the only coherent response.
